name: Minamiizu (Japan)
description: A light blue field charged at the centre with the Minamiizu town emblem in white: a ring of concentric arcs enclosing a stylised letter V.
history: Municipal flag of Minamiizu, a town in Shizuoka Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 21 July 1970.

features.role: Minamiizu town emblem — a ring of concentric arcs enclosing a stylised letter V
